c101_v: A dark, round or oval blob near the centre, ringed by finer light texture: a dark dot inside a lighter disc, or a wheel-like circle with spokes. Fills about half the crop, with fur-like or blurred surroundings. Some crops show a dark centre on pale, frizzy fur.
k163_v: A small, dark, compact blob or round dot with a bright ring around it, sitting in the upper centre of the crop, small against a large smooth, plain or softly blurred background; thin dark hooks or stalks sometimes dangle from it.
k23_v: A rounded, centred blob of fuzzy or smooth pale or tan texture filling much of the crop, with a small dark round patch and two small dark dots above it near the middle; soft outline, plain or blurred surroundings. Smaller: a pale upright figure on a dim background.
k275_v: Many thin straight lines or narrow bands fanning out from one small central hub, like spokes or pleats, often a crossing or star layout, centred and filling most of the crop; also small symmetric ornaments with a pointed vertical centre.
k297_v: A round, roughly circular outline filling the central half of the crop, often with thin radial spokes or concentric rings and a dark ring around a lighter or textured hub, sitting against a darker, plain or blurry surround.
k305_v: Compact, roughly round, fur-textured blob filling most of the crop, centred, with two small upright triangular points at its top corners and a darker small patch low in the middle, on a plain or grassy blurred background. Fainter second pattern: loose, weak clutter.
k97_v: Furry, soft-edged roundish patch filling most of the crop: a dark rounded blob low-centre with two small dark round spots set evenly above it, on dense fine hair-like texture, often pale or tan. Smaller group has a open pink-dark mouth shape.
p_v: A small, dark, round or oval blob at the exact centre, with fine lines (spokes, whiskers, strands) fanning out evenly all around it. Fills a third to half of the crop. Often a ring of circular structure surrounds it, on pale, light-toned ground.
